title: A Day at the Park
text:
It is spring. Lily goes to the park with her dad. The park has a big slide and two swings. Lily likes the swings the most.

In summer, the park is hot, so Lily drinks a lot of water. In autumn, the leaves on the trees turn yellow and fall to the ground. Lily likes to jump in the leaves. In winter, the park is cold and quiet.

questions.text: Who goes to the park with Lily?
What falls from the trees in autumn?
Why does Lily drink a lot of water in summer?
How does Lily probably feel about autumn?
options: She likes jumping in the leaves

vocabulary.definition: a long smooth structure that children go down in a playground
seats hung from bars that children sit on and move back and forth
the flat green or colored parts that grow on trees
the coldest season of the year

paragraph_translations: Es primavera. Lily va al parque con su papá. El parque tiene un tobogán grande y dos columpios. A Lily le gustan más los columpios.

En verano, el parque está caluroso, así que Lily bebe mucha agua. En otoño, las hojas de los árboles se vuelven amarillas y caen al suelo. A Lily le gusta saltar en las hojas. En invierno, el parque está frío y tranquilo.
